children: Indonesia's exports climbed 6.05% year-on-year to USD 26.2 billion in July 2026, surpassing forecasts of a 3.4% rise, though easing from an 8.84% increase in June and marking the second consecutive monthly increase in exports.
Non-oil and gas exports rose 6.84% from a year earlier to USD 25.43 billion, while oil and gas exports plunged 14.58% to USD 0.79 billion.

title: Indonesia Export Growth Beats Forecasts
